hard_rules_points: Added upkeep steps occur in new beginning phases after combat without untap/draw.
Combat damage amount controls steps; Mjolnir doubles dealt damage, not trigger instances.
Wizard's Staff and Roaming Throne each add an additional applicable trigger; simultaneous effects add rather than automatically multiply.
Paradox Haze only fires at first upkeep each turn, not at every generated upkeep.
As Foretold casting permission is once each turn, not per upkeep.
Time Sieve costs five real artifacts per activation; combo not proven.
